body.name: Explicit support compiler
body.construction: At each path layer, encode off-path difference supports as masks, apply upward Boolean subset propagation to mark every deletion mask containing a bad support, scan nonactual table rows to form the finite transitions \(C_i\), and apply the min-plus recurrence \(d_i(t)=\min_s\{d_{i-1}(s)+C_i(s,t)\}\); retain predecessor rows and reachable-value cuts as certificate data.
